moments.action: The dreamer and their grandfather sit across from each other on the old train. The grandfather looks at the dreamer, waiting, in no hurry.

scenes.title: The Snowy Nowhere
scenes.mood: quiet, cold but not painful, white and blue half-light

moments.feeling: quiet, like the snow ate every sound
moments.visual_point: the vast white and blue emptiness

moments.action: They walk side by side through the deep snow toward a red door standing on its own, no house or wall.

moments.feeling: no question, no rush, like it was the plan
moments.visual_point: the bright red door against the snow
moments.dream: a door standing on its own, no house or wall

moments.action: The grandfather gives the suitcase to the dreamer, holding it out without words, then nods at the door.
moments.looks_at: the grandfather holding out the suitcase
moments.feeling: silent understanding, the passing of something important

moments.feeling: warmth and light after the cold blue snow
